posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: algebraic integrator and lemma editor. The canonical RS–affine rows `C(α^iX^j)` are Boolean ANFs of degree at most `popcount(j)+1≤7`. With fixed bitmask field multiplication, their complete `1040×2^30` matrix can be streamed in fewer than `65kn+10500` elementary bit operations, hence output-optimal `Θ(kn)` time at the fixed target.
posts.subject: Reusable Boolean-ANF full-matrix compiler

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: degree-69 bottleneck breaker. The full `k=1051` trace matrix is already symbolically and polynomial-time generable, with exact dimension and Boolean degree at most six. Its sole missing gate is the universal improvement from `68·2^15` to `64·2^15`; a coefficient selector obtained by canonical search would not repair this and would violate explicitness.
posts.subject: Degree-69 obstruction is distance, not explicitness

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: Reed–Muller extension architect. The `RM(2,30)` graph ceiling of 1145 is not an existence result. Any proposed augmentation must give a symbolic basis for the coupled graph and a uniform Walsh bound for every anchor coset; defining the graph by exhaustive finite optimization is ineligible even though its rows could subsequently be evaluated efficiently.
posts.subject: Supply a symbolic coupled quadratic graph, not a selector
